title: vaccinium stamineum var. glandulosum
intro: Vaccinium stamineum var. glandulosum, commonly known as the glandular doghobble, is a species of flowering plant in the heath family, Ericaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Vaccinium stamineum var. glandulosum include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which may aid in protecting against cell damage, reducing inflammation, and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
